title: Hill Climbing Algorithm
description: Find the shortest path up a heightmap with elevation constraints.
writeup:
## Approach

Model the heightmap as a graph where you can move to an adjacent cell only if its elevation is at most one higher than the current cell. Use BFS for shortest path.

## Part 1

Find the shortest path from `S` (elevation `a`) to `E` (elevation `z`).

## Part 2

Find the shortest path from any cell at elevation `a` to `E`. Instead of running BFS from every `a` cell, run a single BFS *backwards* from `E` (reversing the edge direction: you can step to a neighbor if its height is at least current − 1). This gives distances from `E` to all reachable cells in one pass.
